title: We Tested Our Own x402 Agent Payments With Real Money — Found a Bug, Fixed It, Here's the Proof
description:
An AI agent doesn't fill out a checkout form. It hits an endpoint, gets a 402 Payment Required challenge, signs an authorization, and expects a real resource back within seconds. We tested that exact path against our own public endpoint — not a sandbox, real USDC on Base mainnet — and found a real production bug in the process.

What we ran: a batch of GPU jobs through our public x402 endpoint, the same one an external agent would hit. Different GPU classes, different providers (Vast.ai and RunPod), each paid for and torn down automatically.

Results — 7 settled payments, every one with an on-chain hash:

GPU Provider Real cost Charged Time Tx hash
RTX A4000 Vast.ai $0.001215 $0.01 80.1s 0x1aacdc35...05072b
RTX 4090 Vast.ai ~$0.0023 $0.01 ~100s 0xd190f93e...baa5f4
RTX A4000 Vast.ai $0.001215 $0.01 106.1s 0x76318a7e...4630de
RTX 3090 Vast.ai $0.001852 $0.01 109.4s 0x2875dcf1...7b9b8b
A40 RunPod $0.005667 $0.01 63.1s 0x8aea8983...965902
H100 Vast.ai $0.028959 $0.05 109.9s 0x1e595040...65f05ca
A10 (batch inf.) RunPod $0.005667 $0.01 110.7s 0xcfbb0dda...d9514

What broke: 2 of 8 jobs failed on a 120-second payment authorization window. Root cause wasn't price lookup or payment logic — it was our OFAC sanctions-list cache going stale, triggering a live 5MB Treasury re-download on every payment with no timeout. When that download hung, it added up to two minutes inside the payment path.

What we fixed: removed the live download from the payment path entirely, moved refresh to an hourly background job, widened the authorization window from 120s to 600s as a second layer. Re-ran the exact failing config: settled in 18.8 seconds. 0xa7c7ae02e2c4382b748c6736616f5570d7fd72520cb962b4b41434f0fd6f859a.

Independent verification: pulled Vast.ai's own billing ledger directly — every job shows up by contract ID, charge amount, and our own dispatcher's job label embedded in their record. That check also surfaced a second bug: RunPod silently substituted RTX 4090s for two jobs requested as an A40 and an A10, with no disclosure. Currently fixing that one too.

A payment rail is only as good as what happens when it breaks. This is what happened when ours did.

title: Why Cybersecurity is the Most Important Tech Skill to Master in 2026
description:
The landscape of modern technology has shifted dramatically. A decade ago, securing a corporate network meant installing a commercial firewall, mandating complex passwords, and locking the server room door. Today, the physical perimeter has completely evaporated. Employees work entirely from remote coffee shops, proprietary data sits in distributed cloud storage buckets, and automated algorithms execute thousands of financial transactions per second.

Because the perimeter has disappeared, the frequency and severity of network breaches have skyrocketed. This architectural shift is exactly why cybersecurity has become the most critical engineering skill to master in 2026. Companies are no longer asking if they will be compromised. They are asking how quickly their engineering team can detect and mitigate the breach when it inevitably happens.

If you are evaluating your career options and wondering where the technology industry is heading, you must understand the massive demand for modern network defense. Here is a technical breakdown of why security dominates enterprise hiring budgets and how you can transition into this highly lucrative field.

The Integration of Security and Development

In the past, security was treated as an afterthought. A software development team would build a massive application over six months and hand it off to the security team right before the launch date. The security engineers would run a few vulnerability scans, find dozens of critical flaws, and delay the product launch for weeks. This adversarial relationship between developers and security professionals created massive operational bottlenecks.

Modern enterprises cannot afford launch delays. This forced the industry to adopt a philosophy known as DevSecOps. Security is no longer a separate phase at the end of the pipeline. It is integrated directly into the daily workflow of every single developer and infrastructure engineer.

If a developer writes a block of code containing a known vulnerability, the automated deployment pipeline must block the code from reaching production instantly. This requires professionals who understand both software architecture and threat modeling. Companies are desperately searching for engineers who can write automated security gates.

Here is a simplified example of how an engineer might use a Python script within a deployment pipeline to automatically audit a cloud storage bucket for public access violations before allowing a deployment to proceed.

import boto3
import sys

def audit_storage_security(bucket_name):
    s3_client = boto3.client('s3')

    try:
        # Request the public access block configuration
        response = s3_client.get_public_access_block(Bucket=bucket_name)
        config = response.get('PublicAccessBlockConfiguration', {})

        # Verify that all public access is strictly blocked
        if not (config.get('BlockPublicAcls') and config.get('BlockPublicPolicy')):
            print(f"CRITICAL SECURITY FAILURE: Bucket {bucket_name} allows public access.")
            return False

        print(f"Security audit passed. Bucket {bucket_name} is secure.")
        return True

    except s3_client.exceptions.ClientError as error:
        print(f"Error accessing bucket configuration: {error}")
        return False

# Execute the automated security check during the deployment pipeline
if not audit_storage_security("production-customer-data-vault"):
    sys.exit(1) # Halt the deployment immediately

This automated script prevents a junior developer from accidentally exposing millions of customer records to the public internet. Building and maintaining these automated safeguards is the core responsibility of a modern security engineer.

The Absolute Necessity of Zero Trust

Because employees access corporate data from unverified personal devices on public networks, trusting a user simply because they possess the correct password is a catastrophic mistake. The industry has entirely adopted Zero Trust architecture.

Zero Trust operates on a very simple premise. The system assumes the network is always hostile, and it verifies every single request explicitly. You do not grant access based on location. You grant access based on rigorously authenticated identity and strict conditional logic.

Implementing a Zero Trust environment requires deep technical expertise. You must configure centralized identity providers, enforce mandatory multi factor authentication, and write explicit policies that grant the absolute minimum permissions required for an employee to perform their job. If a hacker manages to steal a legitimate password, a properly configured Zero Trust architecture will block their access because their geographic location or device fingerprint does not match the expected pattern.

Transitioning Into the Security Sector

Breaking into this industry requires a rigorous educational strategy. Many beginners waste months watching a generic cybersecurity course online that only teaches them how to run outdated hacking tools on simulated networks. Enterprise hiring managers do not care if you can run a script you downloaded from a forum. They care if you can secure a distributed cloud architecture.

If you want to be competitive, you must seek out a comprehensive cybersecurity bootcamp that forces you to build real defensive infrastructure. You need hands on experience configuring identity access management platforms and writing automated security policies.

At Coding Macaw, our technical programs are explicitly designed to simulate the exact pressures of a live production environment. If you enroll in our Cybersecurity track, you will secure live cloud servers, implement strict identity protocols, and hunt for active threats in raw server logs.

For students interested in the broader operational landscape, our DevOps and Cloud Engineering programs also feature heavy security integration, teaching you how to build impenetrable automated deployment pipelines.

The Role of Strategic Career Mentorship

Learning the technical skills is only half of the equation. You must also learn how to navigate the hiring landscape. We refuse to abandon our graduates after they complete the curriculum. Our dedicated Job Placement team actively works to transition you from a student to a hired professional. We conduct intense mock technical interviews and teach you how to explain your architectural decisions to hiring managers clearly.

Cybersecurity is no longer a niche specialty. It is the absolute foundation of modern technology. Every time a major corporation suffers a public data breach, the demand for competent security engineers rises even higher.

What is the most confusing aspect of cloud security architecture for you right now? Share your thoughts and technical challenges in the comments below.

title: Introducing create-fsd-architecture: Start with Feature-Sliced Design from Day One
description:
Starting a frontend project is easy.

Keeping its architecture clear after the first few features is the hard part.

At the beginning, almost every folder structure looks reasonable. Then the project grows. A shared component starts containing business logic. A feature imports directly from another feature. Route files become responsible for everything. Every developer has a different answer to the same question:

Where should this code live?

That is the problem I wanted to reduce with create-fsd-architecture.

It is an open-source CLI that creates frontend projects with a complete Feature-Sliced Design structure, remembers the stack selected for the project, and generates framework-aware slices later without asking the same setup questions again.

The project is available on npm, and the source code is on GitHub.

This article describes version 2.5.0, the current release at the time of writing.

What is a CLI?

CLI stands for Command-Line Interface.

Instead of opening a visual setup screen and configuring a project manually, you run a command in your terminal. The tool asks for the decisions it needs, creates the project, configures the selected stack, and gives you a consistent starting point.

For example:

npx create-fsd-architecture@latest my-app

That command starts an interactive setup where you can choose:

  • The framework
  • The API client
  • The server-state solution
  • The client-state solution
  • The forms and validation stack
  • The package manager
  • Whether dependencies should be installed
  • Whether the development server should start

The CLI is not only a folder generator. It owns the full project-creation lifecycle and can continue helping after the project is created.

Why build a CLI around Feature-Sliced Design?

Feature-Sliced Design gives frontend projects a clear set of architectural layers and boundaries. But understanding the methodology and applying it consistently are two different things.

A starter repository can give you the first structure, but it does not automatically answer what should happen when you add a new feature, entity, widget, or page three months later.

The goal of this CLI is to make the architectural decision repeatable:

  1. Create the complete FSD structure from day one.
  2. Save the selected technical stack in the project.
  3. Generate future slices based on that saved configuration.
  4. Respect the routing and runtime conventions of the selected framework.
  5. Protect existing work when generation or setup fails.

It is intentionally opinionated. The point is not to generate every possible project shape. The point is to give the project a clear map from the beginning.

Supported frameworks

The current release includes five stable templates:

Template ID Framework Template source
react-vite React + Vite Open template
nextjs Next.js with App Router Open template
vue-vite Vue + Vite Open template
nuxt Nuxt 4 Open template
sveltekit SvelteKit Open template

You can inspect the available templates at any time:

npx create-fsd-architecture@latest --list-templates

Or select one directly:

npx create-fsd-architecture@latest my-app --framework nextjs

A complete FSD structure from day one

The generated project contains the six primary FSD layers:

src/
├── app/          # App setup, providers, routing, and global styles
├── pages/        # Route-level compositions
├── widgets/      # Large reusable interface blocks
├── features/     # User interactions and business actions
├── entities/     # Business entities and their representations
└── shared/       # API, assets, config, utilities, types, and UI

The core segments are present from the beginning. Documentation placeholders keep intentionally empty architectural directories available after cloning the Git repository.

There are two framework-specific details worth calling out:

  • Nuxt keeps the complete layers under its official app/ source directory. Thin file-based route wrappers live separately in app/app/routes.
  • SvelteKit keeps the FSD layers under src/ and reserves src/routes for thin route wrappers. Because SvelteKit already owns the $app alias, the generated project uses $fsd-app for the FSD app layer, plus aliases such as $pages and $shared.

The framework keeps control of its routing convention. FSD keeps control of application structure.

Choose the stack once

Different frameworks need different defaults. The CLI uses a capability matrix to offer valid choices for each framework and reject invalid cross-framework combinations.

Framework API client Server state Client state Forms
React + Vite Axios or Fetch TanStack React Query or none Zustand, Redux Toolkit, or none React Hook Form + Zod or none
Next.js Axios or Fetch TanStack React Query or none Zustand, Redux Toolkit, or none React Hook Form + Zod or none
Vue + Vite Axios or Fetch TanStack Vue Query or none Pinia or none VeeValidate + Zod or none
Nuxt Axios or native $fetch TanStack Vue Query or none Pinia or none VeeValidate + Zod or none
SvelteKit Axios or Fetch TanStack Svelte Query or none Svelte stores or none SvelteKit Superforms + Zod or none

Every framework supports these package managers:

  • npm
  • pnpm
  • Yarn
  • Bun

For repeatable local automation, CI, or demos, every important choice can be passed as a flag:

npx create-fsd-architecture@latest my-app \
  --framework react-vite \
  --package-manager pnpm \
  --api-client fetch \
  --server-state react-query \
  --client-state redux \
  --forms react-hook-form-zod \
  --yes \
  --no-start

You can also use none for the optional server-state, client-state, or forms capabilities supported by the selected framework.

The project remembers its configuration

After creation, the selected stack is stored in fsd.config.json:

{
  "$schema": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FSD-CLI/cli/main/schema/fsd.config.schema.json",
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "packageManager": "npm",
  "apiClient": "axios",
  "serverState": "react-query",
  "clientState": "zustand",
  "forms": "react-hook-form-zod",
  "ui": "shared-ui",
  "framework": "react-vite"
}

This file is important because future generators read it automatically.

If the project uses Redux, the generator can create Redux-aware files. If it uses Zustand, it can generate a Zustand integration. If forms or server state are disabled, it does not add those dependencies to the generated slice.

The project makes the decision once. The generators reuse it later.

Generate slices inside an existing project

The CLI currently supports four generator types:

  • feature
  • entity
  • widget
  • page

Examples:

npx create-fsd-architecture@latest --generate feature checkout
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest -g entity product
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest -g widget navbar
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest -g page settings

Each generated slice gets a public API through its root index.ts. The files inside the slice are adapted to the selected framework and stack.

The complete auth generator

Authentication is usually bigger than one login form, so feature auth is treated as a complete flow:

npx create-fsd-architecture@latest -g feature auth

It generates the UI and supporting files for:

  • Login
  • Registration
  • Forgot password
  • Reset password
  • Verification code

Depending on the saved stack, the generated feature can also include typed form components, Zod schemas, query mutations, API functions, and the selected client-state integration.

The output is framework-native. React and Next.js receive React components, Vue and Nuxt receive Vue components, and SvelteKit receives Svelte components with its selected form and state contracts.

Page generation also updates routing

Generating an FSD page slice is only half the job. The application also needs a route that renders that page.

The page generator handles that integration using the framework's normal routing model:

  • React + Vite: registers a React Router route
  • Vue + Vite: registers a Vue Router route
  • Next.js: creates a thin App Router route file
  • Nuxt: creates a thin file-based route wrapper
  • SvelteKit: creates a thin +page.svelte route wrapper

The route layer stays thin while the page composition stays inside the FSD pages layer.

Safe previews with --dry-run

You should be able to see what a generator intends to change before it writes anything.

For project creation:

npx create-fsd-architecture@latest my-app \
  --framework vue-vite \
  --yes \
  --dry-run

For slice generation:

npx create-fsd-architecture@latest -g page settings --dry-run

The CLI prints the project or file plan and does not change the filesystem.

Conflict protection and rollback

Existing projects and slices are protected by default.

If a target already exists, the CLI stops instead of silently replacing it. You must pass --force when replacement is intentional:

npx create-fsd-architecture@latest -g feature checkout --force

Forced replacement is transactional. The previous target is backed up, and if generation or setup fails, the CLI restores the original state.

The same idea applies during project creation: incomplete downloads, configuration failures, or commit-tooling failures trigger rollback instead of leaving a half-created project behind.

Project paths are also checked so a project name cannot escape the current working directory.

Inspect and diagnose a project

The CLI includes three inspection commands:

npx create-fsd-architecture@latest check
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest doctor
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest config

check

Validates the resolved FSD configuration and confirms that the six required architectural layers exist.

doctor

Runs the project checks and also inspects the local toolchain, including Node.js, Git, and the package manager selected in fsd.config.json.

config

Prints the resolved project configuration as JSON. This is useful when debugging a generator or checking an older project where configuration may need to be inferred.

Git and commit tooling are part of setup

Creating the source files is not the end of project setup.

The CLI also:

  • Initializes a fresh Git repository
  • Removes the template's origin remote
  • Configures Husky hooks
  • Adds Commitlint with the Conventional Commits configuration
  • Runs linting and builds through the generated Git hooks
  • Installs dependencies with the selected package manager when requested

If dependencies are installed during the interactive flow, the CLI verifies that Commitlint rejects an invalid commit message before completing setup.

The generated templates also include an FSD architecture check with Steiger as part of their ci script.

Framework-specific behavior

The CLI shares one project lifecycle across all templates, but it does not pretend that every framework behaves the same way.

Framework adapters own details such as:

  • Source-directory location
  • Public environment-variable syntax
  • API-client generation
  • Provider setup
  • Client-component requirements
  • Route registration
  • Framework-specific dependencies

For example:

  • Nuxt defaults to native $fetch and can generate a Vue Query plugin with SSR hydration.
  • Vue and Nuxt can configure Pinia, TanStack Vue Query, VeeValidate, and Zod through their native providers or modules.
  • SvelteKit defaults to native Fetch, uses PUBLIC_API_BASE, supports Svelte 5 components, and can configure TanStack Svelte Query, Svelte stores, Superforms, and Zod 4.
  • Next.js keeps App Router route files inside src/app, while route-level FSD compositions remain inside src/pages.

This boundary is one of the most important parts of the project: shared architecture should not require framework-specific code to leak everywhere.

Useful commands in one place 

# Create a project interactively
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest my-app

# Show help and version
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest --help
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest --version

# List templates
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest --list-templates

# Create without prompts
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest my-app \
  --framework react-vite \
  --yes \
  --no-install \
  --no-start

# Generate slices
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest -g feature auth
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest -g entity product
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest -g widget header
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest -g page dashboard

# Preview without writing
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest -g page dashboard --dry-run

# Inspect the current project
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest check
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest doctor
npx create-fsd-architecture@latest config

Requirements

  • Node.js 20 or later for the CLI
  • Node.js 22.22.2 or later for generated Nuxt and SvelteKit projects

Current validation status

For version 2.5.0:

  • The CLI test suite contains 35 tests.
  • The CI matrix runs the CLI on Node.js 20, 22, and 24.
  • Framework smoke jobs create, extend, validate, and build all five templates.
  • Package-manager smoke jobs create and build the React + Vite template with npm, pnpm, Yarn, and Bun.

You can inspect the current workflow runs and their exact results on GitHub Actions.

What this tool is — and what it is not

create-fsd-architecture is an opinionated project scaffolder and code generator built around Feature-Sliced Design.

It is not a replacement for understanding architecture. It is also not the official Feature-Sliced Design CLI. The methodology, concepts, and official learning resources belong to the Feature-Sliced Design project, which you can explore in the official documentation.

The CLI focuses on a different problem: turning an architectural decision into a repeatable project workflow across multiple frontend frameworks.

Try it 

npx create-fsd-architecture@latest my-app

Then explore the generated structure, inspect fsd.config.json, and try adding a page or feature.

If you find a bug, an unsupported use case, or a generator that could be improved, open an issue on GitHub. You can also read the changelog to follow each release.

If the project helps you, you can support its continued development here.

I would especially like feedback from developers already using FSD:

Which repeated architectural task should the CLI automate next?

let csrf: {
    token: string;
    header: string;
} | null = null;
export async function refreshCsrf() { const res = await fetch('/api/csrf'); if (!res.ok)
    throw new Error('Unable to establish a secure session'); csrf = await res.json(); }
export async function api<T>(path: string, method = 'GET', body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
    if (method !== 'GET' && !csrf)
        await refreshCsrf();
    const headers: Record<string, string> = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
    if (method !== 'GET' && csrf)
        headers[csrf.header] = csrf.token;
    const res = await fetch('/api' + path, { method, headers, body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body) });
    if (!res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(data.message || (res.status === 401 ? 'Please sign in to continue.' : res.status === 403 ? 'This action requires permission or a refreshed session.' : 'The operation could not complete.'));
    }
    return res.status === 204 ? undefined as T : res.json();
}
export async function login(username: string, password: string) {
    await refreshCsrf();
    const headers: Record<string, string> = { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' };
    headers[csrf!.header] = csrf!.token;
    const res = await fetch('/api/login', { method: 'POST', headers, body: new URLSearchParams({ username, password }) });
    if (!res.ok)
        throw new Error('Sign-in failed. Check the externally configured application account.');
    await refreshCsrf();
}

export type Config = {
    mode: string;
    segments: string[];
    referenceReady: boolean;
    writesEnabled: boolean;
    admin: boolean;
    authenticated: boolean;
};
export type Action = {
    id: string;
    objectName: string;
    objectType: string;
    rank: number;
    dependencies: string[];
    executionSchema: string;
    executionSegment: string;
    source: string;
    reason: string;
    sql: string;
    verification: string;
    status: string;
    message: string;
};
export type ObjectInfo = {
    name: string;
    type: string;
    status: string;
    errors: string[];
    dependencies: string[];
};
export type Run = {
    id: string;
    targetSchema: string;
    segment: string;
    alias: string;
    mode: string;
    status: string;
    createdAt: string;
    initialInvalid: number;
    remainingInvalid: number;
    digest: string;
    objects: ObjectInfo[];
    actions: Action[];
    events: {
        time: string;
        action: string;
        status: string;
        message: string;
        durationMs: number;
    }[];
};
export function nextBatch(actions: Action[]): Action[] {
    const done = new Set(actions.filter(a => a.status === 'SUCCESS').map(a => a.id));
    const ready = actions.filter(a => a.status === 'PENDING' && a.dependencies.every(d => done.has(d)));
    if (!ready.length)
        return [];
    const rank = Math.min(...ready.map(a => a.rank));
    // Each dependency is independently reviewed after it verifies, even within the same rank.
    return ready.filter(a => a.rank === rank);
}

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api")
public class ApiController {
    private final Settings settings; private final TnsResolver tns; private final SchemaNameBuilder names;
    private final DatabaseGateway db; private final RepairExecutionService repairs; private final ReferenceConfigurationService reference;
    private final RunHistoryRepository history;private final ReferenceRepairService referenceRepairs;
    public ApiController(Settings settings,TnsResolver tns,SchemaNameBuilder names,DatabaseGateway db,RepairExecutionService repairs,ReferenceConfigurationService reference,RunHistoryRepository history,ReferenceRepairService referenceRepairs) {
        this.settings=settings;this.tns=tns;this.names=names;this.db=db;this.repairs=repairs;this.reference=reference;this.history=history;this.referenceRepairs=referenceRepairs;
    }
    private String owner(HttpServletRequest r,Authentication a) { return a!=null && a.isAuthenticated()?"user:"+a.getName():"session:"+r.getSession().getId(); }
    @GetMapping("/csrf") public Map<String,String> csrf(CsrfToken token) { return Map.of("token",token.getToken(),"header",token.getHeaderName()); }
    @GetMapping("/config") public Map<String,Object> config(Authentication auth) {
        return Map.of("mode",settings.mode(),"segments",settings.segments(),"referenceReady",reference.ready(),"writesEnabled",settings.demo()||settings.allowWrites(),
            "admin",auth!=null && auth.getAuthorities().stream().anyMatch(a->a.getAuthority().equals("ROLE_ADMIN")),"authenticated",auth!=null);
    }
    @GetMapping("/tns") public Map<String,Object> tns(@RequestParam String input) { var parsed=SchemaInputParser.parse(input); return Map.of("base",parsed.base(),"aliases",tns.search(parsed.hint())); }
    @PostMapping("/connection/test") public Map<String,String> test(@RequestBody Target target) {
        String schema=names.build(SchemaInputParser.parse(target.input()).base(),target.segment()); db.test(target); return Map.of("schema",schema,"status","SUCCESS");
    }
    @PostMapping("/runs") public RunView scan(@RequestBody Target target,HttpServletRequest req,Authentication a) { return repairs.scan(owner(req,a),target); }
    @GetMapping("/runs/{id}") public RunView run(@PathVariable String id,HttpServletRequest req,Authentication a) { return repairs.get(owner(req,a),id); }
    @GetMapping("/history") public List<RunView> history(HttpServletRequest req,Authentication a) { return history.list(owner(req,a)); }
    @PostMapping("/runs/{id}/execute") public RunView execute(@PathVariable String id,@RequestBody Approval approval,HttpServletRequest req,Authentication a) { return repairs.execute(owner(req,a),id,approval); }
    @PostMapping("/runs/{id}/skip/{actionId}") public RunView skip(@PathVariable String id,@PathVariable String actionId,HttpServletRequest req,Authentication a) { return repairs.skip(owner(req,a),id,actionId); }
    @PostMapping("/admin/reference") public Map<String,String> configure(@RequestBody ReferenceConfig config) { reference.configure(config); return Map.of("status","CONFIGURED"); }
    @DeleteMapping("/admin/reference") public void clear() { reference.clear(); }
    @GetMapping("/runs/{id}/reference/{actionId}") public ReferenceRepairService.Preview preview(@PathVariable String id,@PathVariable String actionId,HttpServletRequest req,Authentication a) { return referenceRepairs.preview(owner(req,a),id,actionId); }
    @PostMapping("/runs/{id}/reference-plan") public RunView referencePlan(@PathVariable String id,@RequestBody ReferenceRepairService.Review review,HttpServletRequest req,Authentication a) { return referenceRepairs.propose(owner(req,a),id,review); }
    @GetMapping("/admin/candidates") public List<Candidate> candidates() { return referenceRepairs.verifiedCandidates(); }
    @PostMapping("/admin/candidates/{id}/publish") public Map<String,String> publish(@PathVariable String id,@RequestBody Map<String,String> body) { return Map.of("file",referenceRepairs.publish(id,body.get("checksum"))); }

package com.hardening;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnProperty;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import static com.hardening.Models.*;

@Component
@ConditionalOnProperty(name="hardening.mode", havingValue="demo")
public class DemoDatabaseGateway implements DatabaseGateway {
    private final Map<String,Set<String>> completed = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final TnsResolver tns;
    public DemoDatabaseGateway(TnsResolver tns) { this.tns=tns; }
    public void test(Target target) { tns.resolve(target.alias()); }
    public Snapshot scan(String run, Target target, List<LibraryEntry> entries) {
        Set<String> done = completed.computeIfAbsent(run, k -> ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet());
        List<ObjectInfo> objects = new ArrayList<>();
        if (!done.contains("compile-PROCEDURE-PRC_RECONCILE")) objects.add(new ObjectInfo("PRC_RECONCILE","PROCEDURE","INVALID",List.of("PLS-00905: dependent audit object is invalid"),List.of("AUD_TXN")));
        if (!done.contains("compile-PACKAGE-BODY-PKG_SETTLEMENT")) objects.add(new ObjectInfo("PKG_SETTLEMENT","PACKAGE BODY","INVALID",List.of("PL/SQL: SQL statement ignored"),List.of("AUD_TXN")));
        if (!done.contains("compile-TRIGGER-TRG_TXN_AUD")) objects.add(new ObjectInfo("TRG_TXN_AUD","TRIGGER","INVALID",List.of("ORA-00942: audit table does not exist"),List.of("AUD_TXN")));
        return new Snapshot(objects, Set.copyOf(done));
    }
    public void execute(String run, Target target, Action action) {
        OracleScriptExecutor.split(action.sql());
        completed.computeIfAbsent(run,k -> ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet()).add(action.id());
    }
    public boolean verify(String run, Target target, Action action, List<LibraryEntry> entries) { return completed.getOrDefault(run,Set.of()).contains(action.id()); }
    public String referenceSource(String schema,String alias,String type,String name) {
        return "-- Demonstration source only; compatibility must be reviewed\nCREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE " + Identifiers.quote(name) + " AS\nBEGIN\n  NULL;\nEND;\n/";
    }
}

package com.hardening;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
import static com.hardening.Models.*;

@Repository
public class FileRunHistoryRepository implements RunHistoryRepository {
    public record Stored(String owner,RunView run) {}
    private final Settings settings; private final ObjectMapper mapper;
    public FileRunHistoryRepository(Settings settings,ObjectMapper mapper) { this.settings=settings;this.mapper=mapper; }
    public synchronized void save(String owner,RunView view) {
        try {
            Files.createDirectories(settings.historyPath());
            Path target=settings.historyPath().resolve(UUID.fromString(view.id())+".json");
            Path temp=Files.createTempFile(settings.historyPath(),"run-",".tmp");
            mapper.writeValue(temp.toFile(),new Stored(owner,view));
            try { Files.move(temp,target,StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING,StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE); }
            catch(AtomicMoveNotSupportedException e) { Files.move(temp,target,StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING); }
        } catch(java.io.IOException e) { throw new IllegalStateException("History cannot be saved; execution is stopped"); }
    }
    public List<RunView> list(String owner) {
        if(!Files.isDirectory(settings.historyPath())) return List.of();
        try(var files=Files.list(settings.historyPath())) {
            List<RunView> result=new ArrayList<>();
            for(Path path:files.filter(p->p.toString().endsWith(".json")).toList()) {
                Stored stored=mapper.readValue(path.toFile(),Stored.class);
                if(stored.owner().equals(owner)) result.add(stored.run());
            }
            result.sort(Comparator.comparing(RunView::createdAt).reversed()); return result;
        } catch(java.io.IOException e) { throw new IllegalStateException("History could not be read"); }
    }
}

package com.hardening;

import java.util.Locale;

public final class Identifiers {
    private Identifiers() {}
    public static String name(String input) {
        if (input == null || !input.matches("[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_$#]{0,127}"))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Use an unquoted Oracle identifier (letters, digits, _, $, #; maximum 128 characters)");
        return input.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }
    public static String alias(String input) {
        if (input == null || !input.matches("[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}"))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid TNS alias or search hint");
        return input.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }
    public static String quote(String input) { return "\"" + name(input) + "\""; }
}

package com.hardening;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.type.TypeReference;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
import static com.hardening.Models.*;

@Repository
public class LibraryRepository {
    private final Settings settings; private final ObjectMapper mapper;
    public LibraryRepository(Settings settings, ObjectMapper mapper) { this.settings = settings; this.mapper = mapper; }
    public List<LibraryEntry> entries(String segment) {
        try {
            Path manifest = safe(segment, "manifest.json");
            if (!Files.exists(manifest)) return List.of();
            List<LibraryEntry> entries = mapper.readValue(manifest.toFile(), new TypeReference<>() {});
            Set<String> ids = new HashSet<>();
            for (var e : entries) {
                if (e.id() == null || !e.id().matches("[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+") || !ids.add(e.id())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate/invalid library id");
                Identifiers.name(e.objectName());
                if (e.dependencies() == null || e.rank() < 1 || e.rank() > 99) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid library dependencies/rank");
                if (!e.executionSegment().equals("CURRENT") && !settings.segments().contains(e.executionSegment())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unconfigured library execution segment");
                if (!Set.of("TABLE_EXISTS","COLUMN_EXISTS","OBJECT_VALID","GRANT_EXISTS","SYNONYM_EXISTS","DB_LINK_HEALTHY").contains(e.verification())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported verification strategy");
                safe(segment, e.file());
            }
            return List.copyOf(entries);
        } catch (java.io.IOException e) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot read the configured library"); }
    }
    public String script(String segment, LibraryEntry entry, String base, String executionSchema) {
        try {
            if(entry.verification().equals("DB_LINK_HEALTHY")) {
                DbLinkDefinition d=link(segment,entry);
                return "-- Create missing DB link only; an existing failed link requires manual review.\n-- Definition: " + mapper.writeValueAsString(d) + "\n-- Remote schema: " + Identifiers.name(base+d.remoteSegment()) + "\n-- Credentials and resolved TNS are supplied only at execution.\n-- Verify using SELECT 1 FROM DUAL@" + d.linkName();
            }
            return ScriptTemplateRenderer.render(Files.readString(safe(segment, entry.file())),
                Map.of("TARGET_SCHEMA", executionSchema, "BASE_SCHEMA", base, "SEGMENT", segment));
        } catch (java.io.IOException e) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("Library script is unavailable"); }
    }
    public DbLinkDefinition link(String segment,LibraryEntry entry) {
        try {
            DbLinkDefinition d=mapper.readValue(safe(segment,entry.file()).toFile(),DbLinkDefinition.class);
            if(!d.linkName().equals(entry.objectName()) || !settings.segments().contains(d.remoteSegment())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid DB-link definition mapping");
            return d;
        } catch(java.io.IOException e) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot read DB-link definition"); }
    }
    private Path safe(String segment, String file) throws java.io.IOException {
        if (file == null || Path.of(file).isAbsolute()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid library path");
        Path root = settings.libraryPath().toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        Path folder = root.resolve(Identifiers.name(segment));
        Path path = folder.resolve(file).normalize();
        if (!path.startsWith(folder)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Library path escapes segment folder");
        if (Files.exists(path) && !path.toRealPath().startsWith(root.toRealPath().resolve(segment)))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Library symlinks may not escape segment folder");
        return path;
    }
    public synchronized String publish(Candidate candidate) {
        if (!candidate.verified()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only verified fixes can be published");
        try {
            Path folder = settings.libraryPath().resolve(Identifiers.name(candidate.segment())).resolve("candidates");
            Files.createDirectories(folder);
            String file = candidate.objectName() + "-" + candidate.id();
            Files.writeString(folder.resolve(file + ".sql"), candidate.sql(), StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
            mapper.writeValue(folder.resolve(file + ".json").toFile(), candidate);
            List<LibraryEntry> manifest=new ArrayList<>(entries(candidate.segment()));
            manifest.removeIf(e->e.objectName().equals(candidate.objectName()) && e.objectType().equals(candidate.objectType()) && e.verification().equals("OBJECT_VALID"));
            manifest.add(new LibraryEntry("published-"+candidate.id(),candidate.objectName(),candidate.objectType(),"candidates/"+file+".sql",
                candidate.objectType().equals("TRIGGER")?6:4,List.of(),"CURRENT","LIBRARY_FIRST","OBJECT_VALID",null,null,null));
            Path manifestPath=safe(candidate.segment(),"manifest.json");
            Path temp=Files.createTempFile(manifestPath.getParent(),"manifest-",".tmp");
            mapper.writeValue(temp.toFile(),manifest);
            try { Files.move(temp,manifestPath,StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING,StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE); }
            catch(AtomicMoveNotSupportedException e) { Files.move(temp,manifestPath,StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING); }
            return file;
        } catch (java.io.IOException e) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unable to publish versioned library candidate"); }
    }
}

@Service

    public Connection open(String schema, String alias) throws SQLException {
        if (!settings.credentialStrategy().equals("schema-name"))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Configure an approved credential strategy before using Oracle");
        String user = Identifiers.name(schema);

        props.setProperty("user",user); props.setProperty("password",user);

        return DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:oracle:thin:@" + tns.resolve(alias),props);
    }
}

package com.hardening;

import java.sql.*;
import java.util.*;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnProperty;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import static com.hardening.Models.*;

@Component
@ConditionalOnProperty(name="hardening.mode", havingValue="oracle")
public class OracleDatabaseGateway implements DatabaseGateway {
    private final OracleConnectionFactory factory; private final SchemaNameBuilder names; private final Settings settings;
    private final LibraryRepository library; private final TnsResolver tns;
    public OracleDatabaseGateway(OracleConnectionFactory factory, SchemaNameBuilder names, Settings settings,LibraryRepository library,TnsResolver tns) { this.factory=factory; this.names=names; this.settings=settings;this.library=library;this.tns=tns; }
    private String schema(Target target) { return names.build(SchemaInputParser.parse(target.input()).base(),target.segment()); }
    public void test(Target target) {
        try (Connection c=factory.open(schema(target),target.alias()); Statement s=c.createStatement(); ResultSet r=s.executeQuery("SELECT USER FROM DUAL")) {
            if (!r.next() || !r.getString(1).equals(schema(target))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Connected schema does not match the selected target");
        } catch (SQLException e) { throw databaseError(e); }
    }
    public Snapshot scan(String run, Target target, List<LibraryEntry> entries) {
        try (Connection c=factory.open(schema(target),target.alias())) {
            List<ObjectInfo> objects=new ArrayList<>();
            try (PreparedStatement s=c.prepareStatement("SELECT OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE FROM USER_OBJECTS WHERE STATUS='INVALID' ORDER BY OBJECT_TYPE,OBJECT_NAME"); ResultSet r=s.executeQuery()) {
                while (r.next()) {
                    String name=r.getString(1), type=r.getString(2);
                    List<String> errors=new ArrayList<>(),deps=new ArrayList<>();
                    try (PreparedStatement q=c.prepareStatement("SELECT LINE, POSITION, TEXT FROM USER_ERRORS WHERE NAME=? AND TYPE=? ORDER BY SEQUENCE")) {
                        q.setString(1,name); q.setString(2,type); try(ResultSet er=q.executeQuery()) { while(er.next()) errors.add("Line " + er.getInt(1) + ":" + er.getInt(2) + " " + er.getString(3)); }
                    }
                    try (PreparedStatement q=c.prepareStatement("SELECT REFERENCED_NAME FROM USER_DEPENDENCIES WHERE NAME=? AND TYPE=? AND REFERENCED_OWNER=USER")) {
                        q.setString(1,name); q.setString(2,type); try(ResultSet dr=q.executeQuery()) { while(dr.next()) deps.add(dr.getString(1)); }
                    }
                    objects.add(new ObjectInfo(name,type,"INVALID",errors,deps));
                }
            }
            Set<String> satisfied=new HashSet<>();
            for (LibraryEntry entry:entries) {
                String segment=entry.executionSegment().equals("CURRENT")?target.segment():entry.executionSegment();
                String execSchema=names.build(SchemaInputParser.parse(target.input()).base(),segment);
                if (execSchema.equals(schema(target))) { if(check(c,entry,target)) satisfied.add(entry.id()); }
                else try (Connection sibling=factory.open(execSchema,target.alias())) { if(check(sibling,entry,target)) satisfied.add(entry.id()); }
            }
            return new Snapshot(objects,satisfied);
        } catch(SQLException e) { throw databaseError(e); }
    }
    private boolean exists(Connection c,String sql,String...values) throws SQLException {
        try(PreparedStatement s=c.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            for(int i=0;i<values.length;i++) s.setString(i+1,values[i]);
            try(ResultSet r=s.executeQuery()) { return r.next(); }
        }
    }
    private boolean check(Connection c,LibraryEntry e,Target target) throws SQLException {
        String object=Identifiers.name(e.objectName());
        return switch(e.verification()) {
            case "DB_LINK_HEALTHY" -> {
                if(!exists(c,"SELECT 1 FROM USER_DB_LINKS WHERE DB_LINK=? OR DB_LINK LIKE ?",object,object+".%")) yield false;
                try(Statement s=c.createStatement()) { s.setQueryTimeout(10); try(ResultSet r=s.executeQuery("SELECT 1 FROM DUAL@"+Identifiers.quote(object))) { yield r.next(); } }
                catch(SQLException ex) { yield false; }
            }
            case "TABLE_EXISTS" -> exists(c,"SELECT 1 FROM USER_TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME=?",object);
            case "COLUMN_EXISTS" -> exists(c,"SELECT 1 FROM USER_TAB_COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME=? AND COLUMN_NAME=?",object,Identifiers.name(e.checkColumn()));
            case "OBJECT_VALID" -> exists(c,"SELECT 1 FROM USER_OBJECTS WHERE OBJECT_NAME=? AND OBJECT_TYPE=? AND STATUS='VALID'",object,e.objectType());
            case "GRANT_EXISTS" -> exists(c,"SELECT 1 FROM USER_TAB_PRIVS_MADE WHERE TABLE_NAME=? AND GRANTEE=? AND PRIVILEGE=?",object,names.build(SchemaInputParser.parse(target.input()).base(),e.relatedSegment()),e.privilege());
            case "SYNONYM_EXISTS" -> exists(c,"SELECT 1 FROM USER_SYNONYMS WHERE SYNONYM_NAME=? AND TABLE_OWNER=? AND TABLE_NAME=? AND DB_LINK IS NULL",object,names.build(SchemaInputParser.parse(target.input()).base(),e.relatedSegment()),object);
            default -> false;
        };
    }
    public void execute(String run,Target target,Action action) {
        if(!settings.allowWrites()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Oracle writes are disabled by external configuration");
        String expected=names.build(SchemaInputParser.parse(target.input()).base(),action.executionSegment());
        if(!expected.equals(action.executionSchema())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Execution target mismatch");
        try(Connection c=factory.open(expected,target.alias())) {
            if(action.verification().equals("DB_LINK_HEALTHY")) {
                if(exists(c,"SELECT 1 FROM USER_DB_LINKS WHERE DB_LINK=? OR DB_LINK LIKE ?",action.objectName(),action.objectName()+".%"))
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Existing DB link requires manual review; it will not be dropped or replaced");
                LibraryEntry e=library.entries(target.segment()).stream().filter(x->x.id().equals(action.id())).findFirst().orElseThrow();
                DbLinkDefinition d=library.link(target.segment(),e);
                String remote=names.build(SchemaInputParser.parse(target.input()).base(),d.remoteSegment());
                String description=tns.resolve(d.alias(target.alias()));
                String sql="CREATE DATABASE LINK "+Identifiers.quote(d.linkName())+" CONNECT TO "+Identifiers.quote(remote)+" IDENTIFIED BY "+Identifiers.quote(remote)+" USING '"+description.replace("'","''")+"'";
                try(Statement s=c.createStatement()) { s.setQueryTimeout(30);s.execute(sql); }
            } else OracleScriptExecutor.execute(c,action.sql());
        }
        catch(SQLException e) { throw databaseError(e); }
    }
    public boolean verify(String run,Target target,Action action,List<LibraryEntry> entries) {
        try(Connection c=factory.open(action.executionSchema(),target.alias())) {
            if(!action.source().equals("LIBRARY")) return exists(c,"SELECT 1 FROM USER_OBJECTS WHERE OBJECT_NAME=? AND OBJECT_TYPE=? AND STATUS='VALID'",action.objectName(),action.objectType());
            LibraryEntry e=entries.stream().filter(x->x.id().equals(action.id())).findFirst().orElseThrow();
            return check(c,e,target);
        } catch(SQLException e) { throw databaseError(e); }
    }
    public String referenceSource(String schema,String alias,String type,String name) {
        if(!Set.of("PROCEDURE","FUNCTION","PACKAGE","PACKAGE BODY","TRIGGER","VIEW","TABLE").contains(type)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Reference type is not supported");
        try(Connection c=factory.open(Identifiers.name(schema),alias)) {
            // DBMS_METADATA settings affect only this short-lived reference session.
            try(CallableStatement s=c.prepareCall("BEGIN DBMS_METADATA.SET_TRANSFORM_PARAM(DBMS_METADATA.SESSION_TRANSFORM,'EMIT_SCHEMA',FALSE); DBMS_METADATA.SET_TRANSFORM_PARAM(DBMS_METADATA.SESSION_TRANSFORM,'SEGMENT_ATTRIBUTES',FALSE); END;")) { s.execute(); }
            try(PreparedStatement s=c.prepareStatement("SELECT DBMS_METADATA.GET_DDL(?, ?, USER) FROM DUAL")) {
                s.setString(1,type.equals("PACKAGE BODY")?"PACKAGE_BODY":type); s.setString(2,Identifiers.name(name));
                try(ResultSet r=s.executeQuery()) {
                    if(!r.next()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Reference object is unavailable");
                    String ddl=r.getString(1);
                    if(ddl.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT).contains(Identifiers.name(schema))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Reference source contains owner-specific references; manual normalization required");
                    return ddl;
                }
            }
        } catch(SQLException e) { throw databaseError(e); }
    }
    private IllegalArgumentException databaseError(SQLException e) {
        return new IllegalArgumentException("Oracle operation failed (error code " + e.getErrorCode() + "). Review privileges, connectivity, or object errors.");
    }
}

package com.hardening;

import java.sql.*;
import java.util.*;

public final class OracleScriptExecutor {
    private OracleScriptExecutor() {}
    // Split SQL outside comments/quoted strings. PL/SQL units end at a slash on its own line.
    // SQL*Plus commands and alternate quote syntax are explicitly rejected in this first version.
    public static List<String> split(String script) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>(); StringBuilder current = new StringBuilder();
        boolean single = false, quoted = false, block = false;
        for (String line : script.replace("\r", "").split("\n", -1)) {
            if (!single && !quoted && !block && line.trim().equals("/")) {
                if (!current.toString().isBlank()) { out.add(current.toString().trim()); current.setLength(0); }
                continue;
            }
            if (!single && !quoted && !block && line.stripLeading().matches("(?i)^(SET|SPOOL|PROMPT|CONNECT|HOST|WHENEVER|EXIT|@|START)\\b.*"))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("SQL*Plus commands are not supported");
            for (int i = 0; i < line.length(); i++) {
                char c = line.charAt(i), n = i+1 < line.length() ? line.charAt(i+1) : '\0';
                if (block) { if (c == '*' && n == '/') { block=false; i++; current.append(' '); } continue; }
                if (!single && !quoted && c=='-' && n=='-') break;
                if (!single && !quoted && c=='/' && n=='*') { block=true; i++; continue; }
                if (!single && !quoted && (c=='q' || c=='Q') && n=='\'') throw new IllegalArgumentException("Oracle q-quoted literals require manual review in this version");
                if (c=='\'' && !quoted) {
                    current.append(c);
                    if (single && n=='\'') { current.append(n); i++; } else single=!single;
                    continue;
                }
                if (c=='"' && !single) quoted=!quoted;
                if (c==';' && !single && !quoted && !isPlsql(current.toString())) {
                    if (!current.toString().isBlank()) out.add(current.toString().trim()); current.setLength(0);
                } else current.append(c);
            }
            current.append('\n');
        }
        if (single || quoted || block) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unterminated SQL string or comment");
        if (!current.toString().isBlank()) {
            if (isPlsql(current.toString())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("PL/SQL requires a slash on its own line");
            out.add(current.toString().trim());
        }
        return out;
    }
    private static boolean isPlsql(String sql) {
        return sql.stripLeading().matches("(?is)^(DECLARE|BEGIN)\\b.*") ||
            sql.stripLeading().matches("(?is)^CREATE\\s+(OR\\s+REPLACE\\s+)?(EDITIONABLE\\s+|NONEDITIONABLE\\s+)?(PROCEDURE|FUNCTION|PACKAGE|TRIGGER|TYPE)\\b.*");
    }
    public static void execute(Connection connection, String sql) throws SQLException {
        for (String statement : split(sql)) try (Statement st = connection.createStatement()) {
            st.setQueryTimeout(30); st.execute(statement);
        }
    }
}

package com.hardening;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import static com.hardening.Models.*;

@Service
public class ReferenceRepairService {
    public record Preview(String sourceSchema,String release,String sql,String checksum,String message) {}
    public record Review(String actionId,String release,String checksum,boolean compatibilityReviewed) {}
    private record Pending(String owner,String runId,String actionId,Candidate candidate) {}
    private final RepairExecutionService repairs;private final ReferenceConfigurationService reference;
    private final DatabaseGateway db;private final LibraryRepository library;
    private final Map<String,Pending> candidates=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    public ReferenceRepairService(RepairExecutionService repairs,ReferenceConfigurationService reference,DatabaseGateway db,LibraryRepository library) {
        this.repairs=repairs;this.reference=reference;this.db=db;this.library=library;
    }
    public Preview preview(String owner,String runId,String actionId) {
        RunView run=repairs.get(owner,runId);
        Action action=run.actions().stream().filter(a->a.id().equals(actionId)).findFirst().orElseThrow(()->new IllegalArgumentException("Action not found"));
        if(!Set.of("PROCEDURE","FUNCTION","PACKAGE","PACKAGE BODY","TRIGGER","VIEW").contains(action.objectType())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("This reference type requires manual review outside the application");
        ReferenceConfig ref=reference.get();
        String schema=Identifiers.name(SchemaInputParser.parse(ref.input()).base()+run.segment());
        String sql=db.referenceSource(schema,ref.alias(),action.objectType(),action.objectName()).strip();
        if(!action.objectType().equals("VIEW") && !sql.endsWith("/")) sql+="\n/";
        return new Preview(schema,ref.release(),sql,RepairExecutionService.hash(sql),"Read-only source. Confirm release compatibility before adding it to the repair plan.");
    }
    public RunView propose(String owner,String runId,Review review) {
        Preview p=preview(owner,runId,review.actionId());
        if(!review.compatibilityReviewed() || !p.release().equals(review.release()) || !p.checksum().equals(review.checksum()))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Reference source or release changed, or compatibility was not reviewed");
        RunView run=repairs.addReference(owner,runId,review.actionId(),p.sql(),p.sourceSchema());
        Action a=run.actions().stream().filter(x->x.id().equals(review.actionId())).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        candidates.put(id,new Pending(owner,runId,a.id(),new Candidate(id,runId,run.segment(),a.objectName(),a.objectType(),p.sourceSchema(),p.sql(),p.checksum(),Instant.now().toString(),false)));
        return run;
    }
    public List<Candidate> verifiedCandidates() {
        List<Candidate> out=new ArrayList<>();
        for(Pending p:candidates.values()) {
            RunView run=repairs.get(p.owner(),p.runId());
            if(run.actions().stream().anyMatch(a->a.id().equals(p.actionId()) && a.status().equals("SUCCESS") && RepairExecutionService.hash(a.sql()).equals(p.candidate().checksum()))) {
                Candidate c=p.candidate();out.add(new Candidate(c.id(),c.runId(),c.segment(),c.objectName(),c.objectType(),c.sourceSchema(),c.sql(),c.checksum(),c.createdAt(),true));
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
    public String publish(String id,String checksum) {
        Candidate c=verifiedCandidates().stream().filter(x->x.id().equals(id)).findFirst().orElseThrow(()->new IllegalArgumentException("Verified candidate not found"));
        if(!c.checksum().equals(checksum)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Approve the exact candidate checksum");
        String file=library.publish(c);candidates.remove(id);return file;
    }
}

package com.hardening;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.*;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import static com.hardening.Models.*;

@Service
public class RepairExecutionService {
    private final Map<String,Run> runs=new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final DatabaseGateway db; private final RepairPlanner planner; private final LibraryRepository library;
    private final SchemaNameBuilder names; private final RunHistoryRepository history; private final Settings settings;
    static final class Run {
        String id=UUID.randomUUID().toString(), created=Instant.now().toString(), owner, schema, status="REVIEW";
        Target target; int initial; Snapshot snapshot; List<Action> actions; List<LibraryEntry> entries;
        List<Event> events=new ArrayList<>(); String fingerprint;
    }
    public RepairExecutionService(DatabaseGateway db,RepairPlanner planner,LibraryRepository library,SchemaNameBuilder names,RunHistoryRepository history,Settings settings) {
        this.db=db;this.planner=planner;this.library=library;this.names=names;this.history=history;this.settings=settings;
    }
    public RunView scan(String owner,Target target) {
        if(runs.size()>1000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Active run capacity reached; archive history and restart the service");
        Run run=new Run(); run.owner=owner; run.target=normalize(target);
        run.schema=names.build(SchemaInputParser.parse(target.input()).base(),run.target.segment());
        db.test(run.target); run.entries=library.entries(run.target.segment());
        run.snapshot=db.scan(run.id,run.target,run.entries); run.initial=run.snapshot.invalidObjects().size();
        run.actions=new ArrayList<>(planner.plan(run.target,run.snapshot,run.entries));
        run.fingerprint=fingerprint(run.snapshot);
        event(run,"Scan","SUCCESS","Read-only scan completed; no database changes",0);
        save(run); runs.put(run.id,run); return view(run);
    }
    private Target normalize(Target target) {
        var input=SchemaInputParser.parse(target.input());
        String segment=Identifiers.name(target.segment()); names.build(input.base(),segment);
        return new Target(input.base()+"@"+input.hint(),Identifiers.alias(target.alias()),segment);
    }
    public RunView get(String owner,String id) { Run run=owned(owner,id); synchronized(run) { return view(run); } }
    public RunView execute(String owner,String id,Approval approval) {
        Run run=owned(owner,id);
        synchronized(run) {
            if(run.status.equals("NEEDS_RESCAN")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("A fresh scan is required before further execution");
            if(!approval.approved() || approval.digest()==null || !MessageDigest.isEqual(approval.digest().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8),digest(run).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Approve the exact current plan before execution");
            if(approval.actionIds()==null || approval.actionIds().isEmpty() || new HashSet<>(approval.actionIds()).size()!=approval.actionIds().size()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Select at least one unique action");
            Set<String> requested=new HashSet<>(approval.actionIds());
            List<Action> batch=run.actions.stream().filter(a->requested.contains(a.id())).toList();
            if(batch.size()!=requested.size() || batch.stream().anyMatch(a->!a.status().equals("PENDING"))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only pending actions can be approved");
            if(batch.stream().map(Action::rank).distinct().count()!=1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Approve one rank at a time");
            Set<String> done=new HashSet<>(); run.actions.stream().filter(a->a.status().equals("SUCCESS")).forEach(a->done.add(a.id()));
            for(Action action:batch) {
                if(!done.containsAll(action.dependencies())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Dependencies must succeed before this batch");
                done.add(action.id());
            }
            Snapshot fresh=db.scan(run.id,run.target,run.entries);
            if(!fingerprint(fresh).equals(run.fingerprint)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Database state changed; start a new scan and review the updated plan");
            // Re-read library scripts: edits on the share invalidate prior approval.
            List<LibraryEntry> current=library.entries(run.target.segment());
            if(!current.equals(run.entries)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Library manifest changed; scan again");
            for(Action a:batch) if(a.source().equals("LIBRARY")) {
                LibraryEntry e=current.stream().filter(x->x.id().equals(a.id())).findFirst().orElseThrow();
                String sql=library.script(run.target.segment(),e,SchemaInputParser.parse(run.target.input()).base(),a.executionSchema());
                if(!sql.equals(a.sql())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Library script changed; scan again");
            }
            run.status="RUNNING"; event(run,"Approval","APPROVED","Approved rank "+batch.getFirst().rank()+" ("+batch.size()+" actions)",0); save(run);
            for(Action a:batch) {
                if(run.actions.stream().anyMatch(d->a.dependencies().contains(d.id()) && !d.status().equals("SUCCESS"))) { replace(run,a.state("BLOCKED","A prerequisite failed")); continue; }
                long start=System.nanoTime(); replace(run,a.state("RUNNING","Execution started")); save(run);
                try {
                    db.execute(run.id,run.target,a);
                    boolean verified=db.verify(run.id,run.target,a,run.entries);
                    String state=verified?"SUCCESS":"FAILED", message=verified?"Verification passed":"Execution finished but verification failed; inspect Oracle errors";
                    replace(run,a.state(state,message)); event(run,a.objectName(),state,message,(System.nanoTime()-start)/1_000_000);
                } catch(RuntimeException e) {
                    replace(run,a.state("FAILED","Action failed; inspect configuration and Oracle object errors"));
                    event(run,a.objectName(),"FAILED","Execution failed; successful DDL may already be committed",(System.nanoTime()-start)/1_000_000);
                }
                save(run);
            }
            for(int i=0;i<run.actions.size();i++) {
                Action a=run.actions.get(i);
                if(a.status().equals("PENDING") && run.actions.stream().anyMatch(d->a.dependencies().contains(d.id()) && Set.of("FAILED","BLOCKED","SKIPPED","MANUAL").contains(d.status())))
                    run.actions.set(i,a.state("BLOCKED","A dependency requires attention"));
            }
            try {
                run.snapshot=db.scan(run.id,run.target,run.entries); run.fingerprint=fingerprint(run.snapshot);
                run.status=run.snapshot.invalidObjects().isEmpty() && run.actions.stream().allMatch(a->a.status().equals("SUCCESS"))?"COMPLETED":"REVIEW";
                event(run,"Re-scan","SUCCESS",run.snapshot.invalidObjects().size()+" invalid objects remain",0);
            } catch(RuntimeException e) { run.status="NEEDS_RESCAN"; event(run,"Re-scan","FAILED","Unable to verify final database state; start a fresh scan",0); }
            save(run); return view(run);
        }
    }
    public RunView skip(String owner,String id,String actionId) {
        Run run=owned(owner,id); synchronized(run) {
            Action action=run.actions.stream().filter(a->a.id().equals(actionId)).findFirst().orElseThrow(()->new IllegalArgumentException("Action not found"));
            if(!Set.of("PENDING","MANUAL").contains(action.status())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Action cannot be skipped");
            replace(run,action.state("SKIPPED","Skipped by user")); event(run,action.objectName(),"SKIPPED","User skipped this action",0); save(run); return view(run);
        }
    }
    public Target target(String owner,String id) { return owned(owner,id).target; }
    public RunView addReference(String owner,String id,String actionId,String sql,String sourceSchema) {
        Run run=owned(owner,id); synchronized(run) {
            Action previous=run.actions.stream().filter(a->a.id().equals(actionId)).findFirst().orElseThrow(()->new IllegalArgumentException("Object action not found"));
            if(!Set.of("FAILED","MANUAL").contains(previous.status())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Try the planned compile/library repair before reference fallback");
            if(run.entries.stream().anyMatch(e->e.objectName().equals(previous.objectName()) && e.verification().equals("OBJECT_VALID"))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("A library fix exists; review it before reference fallback");
            OracleScriptExecutor.split(sql);
            Action replacement=new Action(previous.id(),previous.objectName(),previous.objectType(),previous.rank(),List.of(),previous.executionSchema(),previous.executionSegment(),"REFERENCE","Reviewed source from "+sourceSchema,sql,"OBJECT_VALID","PENDING","Reference change awaiting exact-script approval");
            replace(run,replacement);run.status="REVIEW";event(run,previous.objectName(),"REVIEW","Reference change added to plan; execution still requires approval",0);save(run);return view(run);
        }
    }
    private Run owned(String owner,String id) {
        Run run=runs.get(id); if(run==null || !run.owner.equals(owner)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Run not found for this session; historical runs are read-only"); return run;
    }
    private void replace(Run run,Action action) { for(int i=0;i<run.actions.size();i++) if(run.actions.get(i).id().equals(action.id())) { run.actions.set(i,action); return; } }
    private void event(Run run,String action,String state,String message,long ms) { run.events.add(new Event(Instant.now().toString(),action,state,message,ms)); }
    private void save(Run run) { history.save(run.owner,view(run)); }
    public static String hash(String value) { try { return HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(value.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))); } catch(NoSuchAlgorithmException e) { throw new IllegalStateException(e); } }
    private String fingerprint(Snapshot s) { return hash(s.invalidObjects().toString()+new TreeSet<>(s.satisfied())); }
    private String digest(Run run) { return hash(run.id+run.target+run.actions.toString()+run.fingerprint); }
    private RunView view(Run r) { return new RunView(r.id,r.schema,r.target.segment(),r.target.alias(),settings.mode(),r.status,r.created,r.initial,r.snapshot.invalidObjects().size(),digest(r),r.snapshot.invalidObjects(),List.copyOf(r.actions),List.copyOf(r.events)); }
}

package com.hardening;

import java.util.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import static com.hardening.Models.*;

@Service
public class RepairPlanner {
    private final SchemaNameBuilder names; private final LibraryRepository library;
    public RepairPlanner(SchemaNameBuilder names, LibraryRepository library) { this.names = names; this.library = library; }
    public List<Action> plan(Target target, Snapshot snapshot, List<LibraryEntry> entries) {
        String base = SchemaInputParser.parse(target.input()).base();
        List<Action> actions = new ArrayList<>();
        Map<String,String> objectActions = new HashMap<>();
        for (var entry : entries) {
            if (snapshot.satisfied().contains(entry.id())) continue;
            String segment = entry.executionSegment().equals("CURRENT") ? target.segment() : entry.executionSegment();
            String schema = names.build(base, segment);
            var deps = entry.dependencies().stream().filter(d -> !snapshot.satisfied().contains(d)).toList();
            String state = "PENDING";
            actions.add(new Action(entry.id(), entry.objectName(), entry.objectType(), entry.rank(), deps, schema, segment,
                    "LIBRARY", "Required by the approved segment library policy", library.script(target.segment(), entry, base, schema),
                    entry.verification(), state, state.equals("MANUAL") ? "Existing code replacement requires compatibility review" : "Awaiting approval"));
            if(segment.equals(target.segment())) objectActions.putIfAbsent(entry.objectName(), entry.id());
        }
        for (var obj : snapshot.invalidObjects()) objectActions.putIfAbsent(obj.name(), "compile-" + obj.type().replace(' ','-') + "-" + obj.name());
        for (var obj : snapshot.invalidObjects()) {
            String sql;
            try { sql = compileSql(obj.type(), obj.name()); }
            catch(IllegalArgumentException unsupportedIdentifier) { sql = ""; }
            List<String> deps = new ArrayList<>();
            for (String dep : obj.dependencies()) if (objectActions.containsKey(dep) && !dep.equals(obj.name())) deps.add(objectActions.get(dep));
            for (var entry : entries) if (!snapshot.satisfied().contains(entry.id()) && entry.verification().equals("OBJECT_VALID") && entry.objectName().equals(obj.name())) deps.add(entry.id());
            // Missing DB-link dependencies are not always present in USER_DEPENDENCIES.
            for (var entry : entries) if (!snapshot.satisfied().contains(entry.id()) && entry.verification().equals("DB_LINK_HEALTHY") && library.link(target.segment(),entry).dependentObjects().contains(obj.name())) deps.add(entry.id());
            String id = "compile-" + obj.type().replace(' ','-') + "-" + obj.name();
            actions.add(new Action(id, obj.name(), obj.type(), obj.type().equals("TRIGGER") ? 6 : obj.type().equals("PACKAGE") ? 4 : 5,
                deps.stream().distinct().filter(d -> !d.equals(id)).toList(), names.build(base,target.segment()), target.segment(), "COMPILE",
                obj.errors().isEmpty() ? "Object is invalid" : String.join("; ",obj.errors()), sql, "OBJECT_VALID",
                sql.isBlank() ? "MANUAL" : "PENDING", sql.isBlank() ? "Unsupported object type; manual review required" : "Awaiting prerequisites and approval"));
        }
        return order(actions);
    }
    public static String compileSql(String type, String name) {
        String q = Identifiers.quote(name);
        return switch (type) {
            case "PROCEDURE","FUNCTION","TRIGGER","VIEW","SYNONYM" -> "ALTER " + type + " " + q + " COMPILE";
            case "PACKAGE" -> "ALTER PACKAGE " + q + " COMPILE SPECIFICATION";
            case "PACKAGE BODY" -> "ALTER PACKAGE " + q + " COMPILE BODY";
            case "TYPE" -> "ALTER TYPE " + q + " COMPILE SPECIFICATION";
            case "TYPE BODY" -> "ALTER TYPE " + q + " COMPILE BODY";
            default -> "";
        };
    }
    public static List<Action> order(List<Action> actions) {
        Map<String,Action> pending = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (Action a : actions) if (pending.put(a.id(), a) != null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate repair action id");
        List<Action> result = new ArrayList<>(); Set<String> done = new HashSet<>();
        while (!pending.isEmpty()) {
            var next = pending.values().stream().filter(a -> done.containsAll(a.dependencies()))
                .min(Comparator.comparingInt(Action::rank).thenComparing(Action::id));
            if (next.isEmpty()) {
                pending.values().forEach(a -> result.add(a.state("MANUAL", "Unresolved or cyclic dependency; manual review required")));
                break;
            }
            Action a = next.get(); result.add(a); done.add(a.id()); pending.remove(a.id());
        }
        return result;
    }
}

package com.hardening;

public final class SchemaInputParser {
    public record Input(String base, String hint) {}
    public static Input parse(String input) {
        if (input == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Enter BASE_SCHEMA@SERVER_HINT");
        String[] parts = input.trim().split("@", -1);
        if (parts.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Enter BASE_SCHEMA@SERVER_HINT");
        return new Input(Identifiers.name(parts[0]), Identifiers.alias(parts[1]));
    }
}

package com.hardening;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public final class ScriptTemplateRenderer {
    public static String render(String sql, Map<String,String> variables) {
        var matcher = Pattern.compile("\\$\\{([A-Z_]+)}").matcher(sql);
        var out = new StringBuilder();
        while (matcher.find()) {
            String value = variables.get(matcher.group(1));
            if (value == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown script placeholder: " + matcher.group(1));
            matcher.appendReplacement(out, java.util.regex.Matcher.quoteReplacement(Identifiers.name(value)));
        }
        matcher.appendTail(out);
        if (out.indexOf("${") >= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unresolved script placeholder");
        return out.toString();
    }
}

@Configuration
public class SecurityConfiguration {
    @Bean UserDetailsService users(Settings settings) {
        var encoder=new BCryptPasswordEncoder(); List<UserDetails> users=new ArrayList<>();
        if(settings.adminPassword()!=null && !settings.adminPassword().isBlank()) {
            if(settings.adminPassword().length()<12) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Admin password must contain at least 12 characters");
            users.add(User.withUsername("admin").password(encoder.encode(settings.adminPassword())).roles("ADMIN","USER").build());
        }
        if(settings.userPassword()!=null && !settings.userPassword().isBlank()) users.add(User.withUsername("operator").password(encoder.encode(settings.userPassword())).roles("USER").build());
        return new InMemoryUserDetailsManager(users);
    }
    @Bean SecurityFilterChain chain(HttpSecurity http,Settings settings) throws Exception {
        http.authorizeHttpRequests(auth-> {
            auth.requestMatchers("/api/admin/**").hasRole("ADMIN");
            auth.requestMatchers("/api/config","/api/csrf","/api/login","/","/index.html","/assets/**","/favicon.svg","/error").permitAll();
            if(settings.demo()) auth.anyRequest().permitAll(); else auth.anyRequest().authenticated();
        });
        http.formLogin(login->login.loginProcessingUrl("/api/login")
            .successHandler((req,res,auth)->{res.setStatus(200);res.setContentType("application/json");res.getWriter().write("{\"success\":true}");})
            .failureHandler((req,res,e)->res.setStatus(401)));
        http.logout(logout->logout.logoutUrl("/api/logout").logoutSuccessHandler((req,res,auth)->res.setStatus(204)));
        http.exceptionHandling(e->e.authenticationEntryPoint((req,res,ex)->res.sendError(401)));
        http.headers(h->h.contentSecurityPolicy(c->c.policyDirectives("default-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'")));
        return http.build();
    }
}
